gen-gf-warnes-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC tucks a faint stress into its curves. Warnes is best at bold, spacious, unvarying strokes that taper out before touching, while Arsenal SC is best at tight, quiet lines with a wide mouth.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-asimovian: Stretched out and fearless, Warnes draws ink strokes that taper before they touch, while Asimovian stands tall in sturdy sans-serif lowercase. The standout is how both refuse any stroke contrast.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-basic: Warnes draws every stroke at a single thickness, tapering the ink out just before the lines meet. But Basic does the modest work, a sans with only a gentle bump up to its capitals.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-cal-sans: Warnes tapers its ink strokes out before they ever touch. Cal Sans runs one stroke width through its whole alphabet, with short ascenders and a tall x-height, giving Warnes and its stretched tracking a compact, modern partner.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-carlito: Warnes keeps one stroke weight everywhere, its ink lines tapering off before they touch. Carlito, a sans with tight spacing and open round letters, should read smoothly page after page.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-changa: Warnes bends its single-weight lines like glass tubing, spread wide and tapering out before they touch. Changa, a sans-serif with a lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals, does the sturdy, modern work.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-cossette-titre: Warnes holds a single unbroken line weight from terminal to junction, its ink tapering out before it touches. Cossette Titre, a sans with open bowls and nestled letters, should feel smooth going down.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-courier-prime: Warnes stretches out wide in bold, expressive, single-weight ink lines that taper away before they touch. Courier Prime, a monospace, holds a steady drafting-pen line with generous round mouths.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-days-one: Wire-bent sign energy: Warnes holds one constant thickness and tapers its ink off before the lines touch. Days One, a plain sans with an x-height that fills the line, gives that wiry stretch something solid to sit beside.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-epunda-sans: Warnes draws a pressure-free, ballpoint-plain line, stretched wide and tapering out before it touches. Epunda Sans, a plain sans, does the quieter job, with oversized counters full of daylight.
